findings.cause: index.html renders raw backend status and hardcodes every negocio inbox click to #/leads. ops-advisor-inbox concatenates internalNotices, outboxNotices and collaborationNotices without event-level dedupe and broad data scope is incorrectly treated as notification-recipient scope.
findings.fix: Human status labels; dedupe by canonical eventId/entity/direction; exact-recipient targeting; targetSurface advisor→leads operations→ops; per-user read/attended/archive state; preserve exact auto-open.

findings.cause: ciclo.js persists collaboration author from Orbit.session.rol() and timestamp from browser-local stamp(); collaboration payload has no document attachment field.
findings.fix: Use authenticated display name and server-canonical event timestamp/readback; add attachment/documentRef support through existing Drive provider and canonical business mutable fields.

findings.cause: Startup is route-primary but the UI has no durable phase indicator between authentication and usable route render; login routing defaults to/retains Inicio instead of prioritizing actionable collaboration. Exact runtime timing still requires instrumentation, but the silent-state UX defect is demonstrated.
findings.fix: Keep one visible progress state through product-app started + route first render; instrument phase timings; route to pending target surface when actionable notice exists, otherwise role-appropriate default; do not reintroduce full-hydration blocking.

findings.fix: Preserve exact candidate logic and four-column Kanban; rename/explain KPI as expired renewable pipeline and show excluded nonrenewable/terminal context. Re-prove exact real IDs after cleanup.
